visualReview.notes: All nine current portable views inspected, including two new rear details. Final rear cameras were moved above the unchanged uphill source field after initial views from inside the hill were rejected. Front panel geometry remains exact.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All nine current shared-material views inspected, including mapped overlay and both rear details. Metal/concrete bindings and open letter negative spaces retain legibility. Placement transform and unload pass. Flat fixture establishes material/transform behavior; source-native portable/medium-fi views carry the hill context.

mediumFiReview.notes: All 21 current version-2 frames inspected across light/quality, source-native terrain, front/back, rear close-ups and all four forced levels. Separate L stem/foot framing and bounded brace endpoints persist. White-front/gray-back panels and corrugation retained. Synthetic neighbors are style context.

geographicReview.notes: Original nine OSM letter centerlines, anchor [-118.32168815,34.134047800000005], heading 0 and +X east/+Z south retained. Original USGS 3DEP provider-relative datum 480.9181 m, ground under Y and all source elevations unchanged. Source range -4.15881..1.73275 m at mapped vertices and original 0.8 m footing penetration retained; forty actual footing-surface probes pass. Native source spacing is not a claim of elevation accuracy. Initial close cameras were inside uphill terrain; final cameras were raised above it, with no changes to ground or architecture. Current source-native/overlay views inspected. Another host DEM and exact engineering levels remain uncertain.

fidelityReview.scope: Current nine-letter medium-fi steel sign, mapped letter panels and exterior rear structure; former HOLLYWOODLAND, fences, broadcast buildings and landscape objects excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Exact native Blake Everett CC0 rear original already cleared in Qualla was individually inspected; primary own-work grant/revision, no-attribution/no-restrictions metadata and original SHA-1/SHA-256 bound. No new reference photo downloaded. Older CC or additionally flagged images excluded as current controls. Built profile-aware post tops, girts and ladder extents; separate tall-stem/low-foot L braces; diagonal endpoints attach to the actual panel spans instead of extending above O corners. All nine original letter panel Float32 position triangles remain exact, including mapped centers/angles, shapes, width corrections and height offsets. Original twenty footing locations and independent source ground retained. Member sections, hidden engineering, paint color, exact metric dimensions and current condition remain photographic approximations. Previously documented width discrepancy remains unresolved; no new survey, engineering certification or embedded photograph pixels.

limitations: Started with cleared Qualla imagery. Current support construction uses the exact inspected Blake Everett CC0 rear original; older attribution-licensed or additionally restricted imagery is excluded as a current control. Individual OSM letter lines and source ground retained. Not an engineering survey.

Post tops and girt lengths follow letter profiles. The L framework has separate tall-stem and low-foot braces instead of a full rectangle beyond the panel. Member sections, attachment details and hidden engineering remain approximate.
Letter height is 13.716 m (45 ft). The Trust booklet reports 450 ft overall length, while mapped endpoints span about 105 m; mapped positions are retained and this discrepancy remains unresolved.

First O and second L widths are adjusted from short mapped lines to match the photographic proportions; all centers and angles remain mapped. Corrugation, beam sections, joints and ladders are simplified.

Photographic comparison sets approximate panel heights independently of USGS terrain-sampled feet. Native DEM resolution and vertical accuracy are unknown; exact ground contact remains host-terrain dependent.

Earlier HOLLYWOODLAND extension, mountaintop broadcast buildings, fences, surveillance equipment and landscape vegetation are outside this model. Reference photographs are not embedded or redistributed.
